translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Market structure uses CONFIRMED fractal pivots: swing_high(k)/swing_low(k) become known only k bars after the pivot, so no future swing point is used. swing_*(k, j) is the j-th most recent pivot; swing_*_age gives bars since that pivot (used to order points and project trend lines).

strategies.name: Bullish Engulfing at Support
strategies.entry: close[1] < open[1] and close > open and close >= open[1] and open <= close[1] and abs(low - sma(close, 50)) <= $tol * sma(close, 50)
assumptions: 'near SMA(50)' = the low within tol of SMA50

strategies.name: Hammer / Bullish Pin Bar
strategies.entry: (min(open, close) - low) > 2 * abs(close - open) and (high - max(open, close)) < 0.2 * (high - low)

strategies.name: Morning Star
strategies.entry: close[2] < open[2] and abs(close[1] - open[1]) < 0.3 * (high[1] - low[1]) and close > open and close > (open[2] + close[2]) / 2

strategies.name: Piercing Line
strategies.entry: open < low[1] and close > (open[1] + close[1]) / 2
strategies.notes: 2026-11-15 literal correction (gplm verify): previous interpretation added close[1] < open[1] (red prior candle, from the prose); the original formula has no colour condition

strategies.name: Dark Cloud Cover
strategies.entry: open > high[1] and close < (open[1] + close[1]) / 2
strategies.notes: 2026-11-15 literal correction (gplm verify): previous interpretation added close[1] > open[1] (green prior candle, from the prose); the original formula has no colour condition

strategies.name: Three Black Crows
strategies.entry: all_of(close < open, 3) and close < low[1] and close[1] < low[2]

strategies.name: Bullish Kicker
strategies.entry: close[1] < open[1] and open > open[1] and close > open

strategies.name: Break of Structure (Bullish)
strategies.entry: swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))

strategies.name: Change of Character (Bullish)
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) < swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))

strategies.name: Bullish Order Block Mitigation
strategies.entry: barssince(cross_above(close, swing_high(3))) >= 1 and barssince(cross_above(close, swing_high(3))) <= 20 and low <= valuewhen(cross_above(close, swing_high(3)), valuewhen(close < open, high)[1]) and close > valuewhen(cross_above(close, swing_high(3)), valuewhen(close < open, low)[1]) and volume > 1.5 * sma(volume, 20)
assumptions: BOS = close crossing the last confirmed swing high; order block = the last red candle before the BOS bar; retest within 20 bars with a volume spike

strategies.name: Liquidity Sweep / Turtle Soup
strategies.entry: low < lowest(low, 20)[1] and close > lowest(low, 20)[1] and close > open

strategies.name: Higher High, Higher Low (Dow)
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) > swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2)

strategies.name: Double Bottom Neckline Breakout
strategies.entry: abs(swing_low(5) - swing_low(5, 2)) / swing_low(5, 2) < 0.02 and swing_high_age(5) < swing_low_age(5, 2) and swing_high_age(5) > swing_low_age(5) and cross_above(close, swing_high(5))

strategies.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_low(5, 2) < swing_low(5, 3) and swing_low(5) > swing_low(5, 2) and cross_above(close, max(swing_high(5), swing_high(5, 2)))
assumptions: neckline = horizontal at the higher of the two most recent swing highs

strategies.name: Falling Wedge Bullish Reversal
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) < swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and (swing_high(3, 2) - swing_low(3, 2)) > (swing_high(3) - swing_low(3)) and close > swing_high(3) + (swing_high(3) - swing_high(3, 2)) / (swing_high_age(3, 2) - swing_high_age(3)) * swing_high_age(3)
assumptions: converging = the latest high-low swing span narrower than the previous one; breakout above the projected upper line

strategies.name: Fibonacci Golden Pocket Pullback
strategies.entry: swing_low_age(5) > swing_high_age(5) and low <= swing_high(5) - 0.618 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5)) and low >= swing_high(5) - 0.65 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5)) and close > swing_high(5) - 0.618 * (swing_high(5) - swing_low(5))
assumptions: impulse leg = last confirmed swing low followed by the last confirmed swing high

strategies.name: Fibonacci Extension Breakout
strategies.entry: swing_low_age(5) > swing_high_age(5) and cross_above(close, swing_high(5))
assumptions: entry when price clears 100% of the prior swing; the 1.272/1.618 extensions are targets, approximated by the breakout exit profile

strategies.name: Trendline 3rd Touch Bounce
strategies.entry: swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and abs(low - (swing_low(3) + (swing_low(3) - swing_low(3, 2)) / (swing_low_age(3, 2) - swing_low_age(3)) * swing_low_age(3))) <= 0.005 * low and close > open
assumptions: rising line through the last two confirmed swing lows, projected to the current bar; touch tolerance 0.5%

strategies.name: Broadening Formation Lower Boundary Bounce
strategies.entry: swing_high(3) > swing_high(3, 2) and swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and low <= swing_low(3) * 1.01 and (min(open, close) - low) > 2 * abs(close - open)
assumptions: lower boundary approximated by the latest (lower) swing low; hammer = lower wick > 2 x body

strategies.name: Quasimodo (Over and Under) Reversal
strategies.entry: swing_low(3) < swing_low(3, 2) and swing_high(3) > swing_high(3, 2) and swing_high_age(3) < swing_low_age(3) and low <= swing_low(3, 2) * 1.005 and close > swing_low(3, 2)
assumptions: bullish QM: lower low then higher high (the high is the more recent pivot), entry on a retest of the left-shoulder low

strategies.name: 2B Reversal Rule
strategies.entry: low < swing_low(5) and close > swing_low(5)

strategies.name: Ross Hook
strategies.entry: barssince(swing_low(3) > swing_low(3, 2) and cross_above(close, swing_high(3))) <= 10 and any_of(close < close[1], 2)[1] and close > highest(high, 3)[1]
assumptions: 1-2-3 breakout within the last 10 bars, a 1-2 bar pullback, then close above the 3-bar hook high
